assets.description: A blue-and-cream humanoid robot with a circuit workpiece and assembly probe.
assets.notice: Authored 3D; seamless loops are not certified. Video timing may differ from 3D clips. Weft alignment remains unverified.

states.label: Idle
states.meaning: Friendly attentive body rock with tools held at waist height and both feet planted.

states.label: Working
states.meaning: Raises the circuit workpiece toward the face and leans forward to inspect it while the probe hand rests.

states.label: Making something
states.meaning: Uses repeated short probe strokes toward the waist-held circuit guide while the left arm steadies it; guide marks remain fixed.

states.label: Milestone level up
states.meaning: Raises both tools above shoulder level with one cheerful hop and a preparatory knee bend.

assets.title: Workshop robot

assets.description: An authored panda with a green shoulder dragon and golden crafting sphere, inspired by the supplied reference.
assets.notice: Authored 3D; seamless loops are not certified. Weft alignment remains unverified.

states.label: Idle
states.meaning: Gentle attentive upper-body sway while both paws support the sphere and the shoulder dragon remains securely perched.

states.label: Working
states.meaning: Lifts the sphere toward its face with the anatomical right arm and leans in to inspect it; fingers and head remain rest descendants.

states.label: Making something
states.meaning: Alternates small forearm strokes around the sphere in a crafting gesture. The sphere remains fixed-shape; no new material is generated.

states.label: Milestone level up
states.meaning: Raises both paws and the sphere above shoulder level during one joyful hop, with a small preparatory knee bend and fixed shoulder dragon.

assets.title: Muse-inspired panda

assets.description: An articulated fox with a teal scarf, sketchbook and pencil.
assets.notice: Authored 3D; seamless loops are not certified. Video timing may differ from 3D clips.

states.label: Idle
states.meaning: Quiet attentive breathing, alternating ear twitches and a slow tail sway.

states.label: Making something
states.meaning: Looks down at the sketchbook and draws a craft pattern with several short pencil strokes.

states.label: Milestone level up
states.meaning: Raises both paws clearly above shoulder level, displaying the sketchbook and pencil during one delighted hop, then returns to rest.

states.label: Working
states.meaning: Raises the sketchbook toward its face and reads it with a pronounced downward gaze and slow page scan; pencil hand stays resting.

assets.title: Fox craftsperson

assets.description: A burgundy-and-brass lamp with a moving shade, mechanical joints and tracing stylus.
assets.notice: Authored 3D; seamless loops are not certified. Video timing may differ from 3D clips.

states.label: Idle
states.meaning: A small inquisitive look-around: base swivel and two opposing shade tilts.

states.label: Making something
states.meaning: Lowers the visible stylus onto its fixed circular guide and traces two back-and-forth arcs while the shade aims at the pad. No new marks are generated.

states.label: Milestone level up
states.meaning: Stretches into a proud upright pose and gives two delighted shade nods before folding back.

states.label: Working
states.meaning: Leans toward the work pad and makes a broad slow inspection sweep, unlike the short repetitive tracing state.
